propositions: Retire phantom orphaned/duplicates/stale SYNC checks from bridge fsck output; remove from all consumers: CLI, library, MCP schema, help text, and release notes.
Detect unknown event types by grepping refs/heads/tickets without checkout, then validate top-level event_type against KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES; report only confirmed matches.
Add store_integrity audit to verify forward/reverse binding consistency with six specific finding kinds; make inconsistencies gate fsck exit status to 1.
Preserve informational semantics: unknown_event_types and binding_drift remain non-gating; Git/ref operational failures raise RebarError(returncode=2) and produce CLI exit 2.
Remove SYNC-only stale-detection machinery: delete _STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts, and related test fixtures.
Ensure rebar bridge-fsck compatibility command produces identical output and exit semantics as canonical rebar bridge fsck.
